thig13.3:1.1: Rohiṇī. || laṭṭhihattho pure āsiṃ so dāni migaluddako | āsāya palipā ghorā nāsakkhiṃ pāram etase. || ||
thig13.3:2.1: sumattaṃ maṃ maññamānā Cāpā puttam atosayi | Cāpāya bandhanaṃ chetvā pabbajissaṃ puno-m-ahaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:3.1: mā me kujjha mahāvīra mā me kujjha mahāmuni | na hi kodhaparetassa suddhi atthi kuto tapo. || ||
thig13.3:4.1: pakkāmissañ ca Nālāto ko 'dha Nālāya vacchati | bandhanti itthirūpena samaṇe dhammajīvino. || ||
thig13.3:5.1: ehi Kāḷa nivattassu bhuñja kāme yathā pure | ahaṃ ca te vasīkatā ye ca me santi ñātakā. || ||
thig13.3:6.1: etto ceva catubbhāgaṃ yathā bhāsasi taṃ Cāpe | tayi rattassa posassa uḷāraṃ vata taṃ siyā. || ||
thig13.3:7.1: Kāḷa 'ṅginiṃ va takkāriṃ pupphitaṃ girimuddhani | phullaṃ dālikalaṭhiṃ va antodīpe va pāṭaliṃ || ||
thig13.3:8.1: haricandanalittaṅgiṃ kāsikuttamadhāriniṃ | taṃ maṃ rūpavatiṃ santiṃ kassa ohāya gacchasi. || ||
thig13.3:9.1: sākunitikko va sakuṇiṃ yathā bandhitum icchati | āharimena rūpena na maṃ tvaṃ bādhayissasi. || ||
thig13.3:10.1: imaṃ ca me puttaphalaṃ Kāḷa uppāditaṃ tayā | taṃ maṃ puttavatiṃ santiṃ kassa ohāya gacchasi. || ||
thig13.3:11.1: jahanti putte sappaññā tato ñātī tato dhanaṃ | pabbajanti mahāvīrā nāgo chetvā va bandhanaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:12.1: idāni te imaṃ puttaṃ daṇḍena churikāya vā | bhūmiyyaṃ vā nisumbheyyaṃ puttasokā na gacchasi. || ||
thig13.3:13.1: sace puttaṃ sigālānaṃ kukkurānaṃ padāhisi | na maṃ puttakate jammi punar āvattayissasi. || ||
thig13.3:14.1: handa kho dāni bhaddan te kuhiṃ Kāḷa gamissasi | katamaṃ gāmaṃ nigamaṃ nagraṃ rājadhāniyo. || ||
thig13.3:15.1: ahumha pubbe gaṇino asamaṇā samaṇamānino | gāmena gāmaṃ vicarimha nagare rājadhāniyo. || ||
thig13.3:16.1: eso hi bhagavā buddho nadiṃ Nerañjaraṃ pati | sabbadukkhappahānāya dhammaṃ desesi pāṇinaṃ | tassāhaṃ santike gacchaṃ so me satthā bhavissati. || ||
thig13.3:17.1: vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ | padakkhiṇañ ca katvāna ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:18.1: etaṃ kho labbham amhehi yathā bhāsasi taṃ Cāpe | vandanaṃ dāni te vajjaṃ lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ | padakkhiṇañ ca katvāna ādisissāmi dakkhiṇaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:19.1: tato ca Kāḷo pakkāmi nadiṃ Nerañjaraṃ pati | so addasāsi sambuddhaṃ desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:20.1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ | ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ. || ||
thig13.3:21.1: tassa pādāni vanditvā katvāna naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ | Cāpāya ādisitvāna pabbaji anagāriyaṃ | tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
